mapper.select: select project_id AS projectId, project_name AS projectName, project_name_abbreviation AS projectNameAbbreviation from basic_v2_project_manage where active_flg = 1 and department_id = #{departmentId}

select count(staff_id) from basic_v2_project_detail where project_id = #{projectId} and active_flg = 1 and entry_date <= #{lastDayOfMonth} and ( (actual_exit_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_exit_date >= #{queryMonth}) OR (actual_exit_date IS NULL AND (planned_exit_date IS NULL OR planned_exit_date >= #{queryMonth})) )

select pd.staff_id AS staffId from basic_v2_project_detail pd join basic_v2_company_management c on pd.company_id = c.company_id where pd.project_id = #{projectId} and pd.active_flg = 1 and LOWER(c.company_abbreviation) = 'ucl'

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, c.total_sales_amount AS totalSalesAmount, c.previous_month_actuarial_balance AS previousMonthActuarialBalance, c.trading_status AS tradingStatus FROM basic_v2_project_manage p INNER JOIN basic_v2_clearing_balance c ON p.project_id = c.project_id WHERE p.active_flg = 1 AND p.project_id IN
#{projectId}
SELECT daily_operating_hours FROM basic_v2_project_manage WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND active_flg = 1;
SELECT work_days FROM basic_v2_year_and_month WHERE month = STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(#{month}, '%Y-%m'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d');

SELECT SUM(COALESCE(pd.sales_amount, 0)) FROM basic_v2_project_detail pd join basic_v2_company_staff s on pd.staff_id = s.staff_id join basic_v2_company_management c on s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE pd.project_id = #{projectId} AND pd.active_flg = 1;

SELECT the_month_of_residual_amount FROM basic_v2_clearing_balance WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(target_month, #{preMonth}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(target_month, #{preMonth}) < 31 And active_flg = 1;
SELECT closing_date FROM basic_v2_company_management WHERE company_id = #{salesCompanyId} AND active_flg = 1;
SELECT settlement_upper_limit AS settlementUpperLimit, settlement_lower_limit AS settlementLowerLimit FROM basic_v2_project_manage WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND active_flg = 1

SELECT previous_month_actuarial_balance AS previousMonthActuarialBalance FROM basic_v2_clearing_balance WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND DATEDIFF(target_month, #{queryMonth}) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(target_month, #{queryMonth}) < 31 AND active_flg = 1;
